This site needs JavaScript to run.

Export & backup

Your edits are saved in this browser automatically. To keep them safely or move them to another device, download the wiki.

Unzip it and upload the whole folder. The styles are in css/site.css, the wiki in data/wiki.js, and it also opens straight from the folder on your computer.

Upload the file to your Neocities dashboard (drag it in). The page is a single file, so nothing else needs to go with it.

Export one part Import one part Stats & facts

Change a number here and every page that uses it updates. Numbers can be written like 230 million, or as a formula like =pop_fn_0*2. In any page, write {{stat:key}} or use the Stat button in the editor.
